assessment: Synthetic observations associate assignment changes and renames with errors; causation is unproven. These are alternative bounded hypotheses. Neither establishes split-course safety, implementation cost, or the success target.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: adapt museum accession tags, which separate identity from display labels, into a center-and-week course manifest. Cross identity continuity with coordinator reconciliation at the manifest-to-export interface: the confirmed course set drives the existing CSV generator.
openings.delta: Replace current-assignment selection with explicit weekly membership. Repurpose the existing course list as a reconciliation surface. Failed correspondence: one accession tag cannot describe a course splitting into two; splits require explicit weekly membership decisions. Changed assumptions: names and current instructors need not define historical inclusion.
openings.prediction: The hybrid reduces omissions after reassignment or renaming while avoiding a second full spreadsheet comparison; split cases may still require clarification.
openings.probe: Verify course-list provenance and available identifiers first. With fabricated reassignment, rename, and split cases, compare incumbent selection against manifest selection; measure intended-set accuracy and reconciliation time. Reject any cross-center rows or interrupted attendance entry.
assumptions: Stable center-scoped identity and historical membership are unverified enabling dependencies; do not infer missing history.
Coordinator reference schedules may be incomplete.
Private processing, unchanged CSV support, nonblocking reads, hosting cost, and six-day feasibility require verification.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: adapt parcel pickup notifications into private export-ready receipts. Cross authorized replacement requests with completion-triggered retrieval at a request-to-artifact interface.
openings.delta: Repurpose existing completion logs as readiness signals. Failed correspondence: job completion does not establish correct course contents. Changed assumption: replacement delivery can follow completion instead of an operator handoff.
openings.prediction: Replacement waiting falls if operator handoffs cause the delay; active handling and course accuracy may remain unchanged.
openings.probe: Verify whether logs can bind an authorized center/week request to its exact private CSV. Across two short sessions per consenting coordinator, share the session budget with A1 and separately time checking, requesting, waiting, downloading, and importing. Subsequently assess 40 exports against all stated success measures.
assumptions: Request/artifact identifiers, authorization checks, and completion hooks are unverified dependencies.
Use unchanged CSVs within authorized workspaces; bound retries and verify concurrency, hosting, and six-day feasibility.
